description: Angular component for displaying and managing entity filters in the Thingsboard UI, including translation and display logic for various filter types.

classes.name: EntityFilterViewComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor to display and handle entity filter visualization and translation.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to call when the filter value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback function to call when the filter component is touched.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Sets the disabled state of the component.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the filter value and updates the display string based on filter type, using translation service.
